tool_signatures.name: assignConversation
tool_signatures.description: Assign a Help Scout conversation to a user. Reversible with assignConversation or unassignConversation.

tool_signatures.name: createNote
tool_signatures.description: Add an internal note to a Help Scout conversation. Notes are visible to teammates only and never notify the customer. The Mailbox API has no endpoint to delete a note.

tool_signatures.name: downloadAttachmentFile
tool_signatures.description: Download a Help Scout attachment file as base64 with response metadata.

tool_signatures.name: findDocsRedirect
tool_signatures.description: Resolve a Help Scout Docs redirect target from a site ID and URL path.

tool_signatures.name: getAttachment
tool_signatures.description: Get base64-encoded Help Scout attachment data by conversation and attachment ID.

tool_signatures.name: getConversationSummary
tool_signatures.description: Get conversation summary with first customer message and latest staff reply

tool_signatures.name: getDocsArticle
tool_signatures.description: Get one Help Scout Docs article by ID or number.

tool_signatures.name: getDocsArticleRevision
tool_signatures.description: Get one Help Scout Docs article revision by ID.

tool_signatures.name: getDocsCategory
tool_signatures.description: Get one Help Scout Docs category by ID or number.

tool_signatures.name: getDocsCollection
tool_signatures.description: Get one Help Scout Docs collection by ID or number.

tool_signatures.name: getDocsRedirect
tool_signatures.description: Get one Help Scout Docs redirect by ID.

tool_signatures.name: getDocsReport
tool_signatures.description: Get the Help Scout Docs overall report for a bounded time range.

tool_signatures.name: getDocsSite
tool_signatures.description: Get one Help Scout Docs site by ID. Set includeRestrictions to also attach the restricted-site settings (secrets redacted).

tool_signatures.name: getHappinessReport
tool_signatures.description: Get a Help Scout happiness report for a bounded time range. report=overall (/reports/happiness) or ratings (/reports/happiness/ratings).

tool_signatures.name: getOrganization
tool_signatures.description: Get an organization by ID with optional customer/conversation counts.

tool_signatures.name: getOrganizationConversations
tool_signatures.description: Get all conversations associated with an organization. Traverses org-to-conversations without needing individual customer lookups. Returns 50 per page.

tool_signatures.name: getOrganizationMembers
tool_signatures.description: Get all customers belonging to an organization. Use after getOrganization to see who is in the org. Returns 50 per page.

tool_signatures.name: getOrganizationProperty
tool_signatures.description: Get one organization property definition by slug. Use after listOrganizationProperties when exact option labels are needed.

tool_signatures.name: getOriginalSource
tool_signatures.description: Get the original source for a Help Scout conversation thread. Set format to "rfc822

tool_signatures.name: getSatisfactionRating
tool_signatures.description: Get a Help Scout satisfaction rating by ID.

tool_signatures.name: getSavedReply
tool_signatures.description: Get one saved reply from a Help Scout inbox by ID.

tool_signatures.name: getServerTime
tool_signatures.description: Get the current MCP host timestamp. Use before date-relative searches to calculate time ranges.

tool_signatures.name: getTag
tool_signatures.description: Get a Help Scout tag by ID. Use after listTags when an exact tag record is needed.

tool_signatures.name: getTeamMembers
tool_signatures.description: List members of a Help Scout team. Use after listTeams to discover user IDs in a team.

tool_signatures.name: getWebhook
tool_signatures.description: Get a Help Scout webhook by ID.

tool_signatures.name: listAllInboxes
tool_signatures.description: List all inboxes with IDs. Pass nameContains to filter by a case-insensitive name substring. Deprecated: inbox IDs now in server instructions. Only needed mid-session.

tool_signatures.name: listCustomerProperties
tool_signatures.description: List customer property definitions. Use to interpret custom property values embedded on customer records.

tool_signatures.name: listDocsArticleRevisions
tool_signatures.description: List Help Scout Docs article revisions.

tool_signatures.name: listDocsArticles
tool_signatures.description: List Help Scout Docs articles for a collection or category.

tool_signatures.name: listDocsCategories
tool_signatures.description: List Help Scout Docs categories for a collection.

tool_signatures.name: listDocsRedirects
tool_signatures.description: List Help Scout Docs redirects for a site.

tool_signatures.name: listDocsRelatedArticles
tool_signatures.description: List Help Scout Docs articles related to an article.

tool_signatures.name: listDocsSites
tool_signatures.description: List Help Scout Docs sites using the Docs API v1.

tool_signatures.name: listOrganizationProperties
tool_signatures.description: List organization property definitions. Use to interpret custom company property values embedded on organizations.

tool_signatures.name: listOrganizations
tool_signatures.description: List all organizations with sorting options. Use for discovering organizations before drilling into members or conversations. Returns 50 per page.

tool_signatures.name: listSavedReplies
tool_signatures.description: List saved replies for a Help Scout inbox. Use to discover saved reply IDs and inspect reusable response templates.

tool_signatures.name: listTags
tool_signatures.description: List Help Scout tags used across inboxes. Use to discover tag IDs and exact names before filtering conversations or reports.

tool_signatures.name: listTeams
tool_signatures.description: List Help Scout teams. Use to discover team IDs before team-member lookup or team-scoped reporting.

tool_signatures.name: listWebhooks
tool_signatures.description: List Help Scout webhooks. Use to inspect webhook configuration and discover webhook IDs.

tool_signatures.name: listWorkflows
tool_signatures.description: List Help Scout workflows. Use to inspect account workflow configuration and discover workflow IDs.

tool_signatures.name: moveConversation
tool_signatures.description: Move a Help Scout conversation to a different inbox. Reversible by moving it back to the original inbox.

tool_signatures.name: searchCustomersByEmail
tool_signatures.description: Search customers by email address using the v3 API. Provides email as a dedicated filter parameter (vs query syntax in v2) and cursor-based pagination.

tool_signatures.name: sendReply
tool_signatures.description: Send a reply to the customer on a Help Scout conversation. This emails the customer immediately and cannot be recalled. Requires HELPSCOUT_ENABLE_CUSTOMER_VISIBLE_WRITES and per-call confirmation. Use createDraftReply to compose without sending.

tool_signatures.name: snoozeConversation
tool_signatures.description: Snooze a Help Scout conversation until a future time. Each call replaces any previous snooze. Reversible with unsnoozeConversation.
